cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.
